👋 Welcome

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 MY FAMILY ⏱ ~2 hours

An interactive A2 English lesson — Easy Peasy TN, by Sahar Belghith

Hello! 👋 Today we are going to talk about something very special: our families! We will meet Paul's family, learn new words, play lots of games, watch a video, read a story, and build our very own family tree. 🌳❤️

🎯 Today I Can...

  • Name family members
  • Talk about my own family
  • Use family vocabulary
  • Use have got / has got
  • Ask and answer WH questions
  • Understand a video about Paul's family
  • Understand a reading text
  • Create a family tree
  • Write about my family

Part 7 ⏱ 15–20 min

📚 Have Got / Has Got

We use have got and has got to talk about family and possessions.

✅ Positive

I / You / We / They have got
He / She / It has got

"Paul has got two sisters."
"I have got a brother."

🚫 Negative

I haven't got a sister.
She hasn't got a brother.

❓ Questions

Have you got a brother?
Has she got a sister?

💬 Short Answers

Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
Yes, she has. / No, she hasn't.

Part 10 ⏱ 10–15 min

✍️ My Family — Writing

Write a short paragraph about your own family. Use the guide below to help you, then write your own sentences!

My name is ______. I am ______ years old. There are ______ people in my family. I have got ______. My mother is ______. My father is ______. I have got ______ brother(s) and ______ sister(s). My family likes ______. We usually ______ together. I love my family because ______.
